description: Show/hide individual designs in the Helping Hands design viewer. Jake (voice): 'Can we have the option to show or hide a particular design in one thing? Like, I don't really care about Gen 1 or Gen 2 right now.' Ask: a per-design visibility toggle so Jake can hide designs (e.g. gripper Gen 1 and Gen 2) from the designs list/viewer and unhide them later; the choice persists. Make the action reachable by voice too.

results.identified_issue: Which viewer: 'Gen 1/Gen 2' matched the Live Preview gallery (cad/mobile_gallery, served from ~/HelpingHands-tools/design-gallery by Scripts/serve_designs.py on :8768). Its Generalist Gripper family labels demo-gripper-gen-00/01 as Gen 1/2. I did not change the Swift Designs tab, the workbench or cad/compare/designs.py. The workbench and designs.py also had someone else's uncommitted edits. The hidden state is <gallery>/hidden.json, not in the repo: the publisher never wipes the out dir, and a repo file would be runtime state dirtying git. If the curated dir is deleted, the hidden list resets. Server POST is JSON-only (blocks simple cross-site form posts) and id-regex validated. gallery.js/index.html/serve_designs.py/README.txt are untracked files that predate me (another session's work). Per the shared-checkout rule I edited them but did not commit them. Only Scripts/design_visibility.py and its test are committed. Not verified on a physical phone.
results.summary: Live Preview now has a Hide… button per family; Gen 1 and Gen 2 of the gripper are already hidden
results.detailed_description:
In the Live Preview gallery there's a new button next to the family picker. It says “Hide…”, or “2 hidden” once some are hidden. Tap it to get a checklist of that family's generations. Uncheck one and it leaves the comparison right away. Check it again to bring it back. You said you didn't care about Gen 1 and Gen 2, so I've already hidden them. The gripper view now opens on Gen 3–6.

The choice is saved on the Mac as one small file (hidden.json, next to the gallery's catalog). So it sticks across refreshes and republishes, and it's the same on the phone and the Mac. To save it, the gallery server got its first write endpoint, POST /hidden.json. It only accepts JSON holding a list of design ids, so it can't write anything else. I restarted the design-preview launch agent so it picked that up.

Voice: Scripts/design_visibility.py hide gripper gen 1 2, show gripper gen 1, show all, or list. It understands “gen two”, “gen1” and “orca v2”. If a name matches more than one design, it refuses and lists the matches instead of guessing.

Tested: unit tests for the voice matcher, plus a headless Chrome run of the real page at phone size. Hiding, showing, saving and the everything-hidden message all worked. I haven't looked at it on your actual phone.

One thing to know: the gallery page, its server and README are files that are in the checkout but have never been committed. I edited them in place, and they're live now. But I only committed my own new files, the voice script and its test. Someone should commit cad/mobile_gallery/ and Scripts/serve_designs.py (and publish_designs.py) so this doesn't get lost.
results.user_reply_draft: Hey Jake — done. There's a Hide… button next to the family picker in Live Preview now. Tap it, uncheck the generations you don't want, and they stay hidden until you check them again. I've already tucked away gripper Gen 1 and Gen 2 for you. You can also just say "hide gripper gen 1" or "show all".

summary: The Helping Hands design viewer has no way to hide individual designs, so Jake can't declutter old ones like gripper Gen 1 and Gen 2. Add a per-design show/hide toggle that persists and can be undone later, and make it usable by voice.
